roads.name: Chaco Loop Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 8 curves in 3.6 miles.
From 6,104 to 6,192 ft, with 151 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 90°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 30 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.26 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
